t1.text: The Watching now row on Saved

n1.text:
Real TMDB data, checked 2026-11-15.

Breaking Bad: ended, 62 episodes. Next S2 · E9 means 7 + 8 = 15 watched.
Silo: caught up; TMDB gives S4 · E1 for 8 July 2027 and already lists it, so the bar says 30 of 31.
Slow Horses: caught up, no next date.
Леся + Рома: added by hand, so no bar and never Caught up.
Severance: just started.

Tweaks switches every board between dark and light.

picks.text:
Picked 2026-11-15:
The row: A (a bar in the row, a round check behind a divider, the air date in the status line).
The series' page: A (a Watching card, a round check, two steppers).

r2t1.text: A series' page in its other states

r2n1.text:
Built from the round 1 picks (A and A).

Not started: Start watching sits in the action row and opens no dialog.
Caught up: no check, since nothing has aired; the steppers still move, so an episode TMDB lacks can be set.
Rated before: Watch more takes Start watching's place.
By hand: no bar, no "of 13", and the steppers have no upper end.

r2n2.text:
A bottom sheet on a phone, a centred dialog on the web, as the Watched dialog is.

"From season 5" is the latest season TMDB lists and is chosen when the sheet opens, so the usual case is one tap on Start watching.

The steppers show only under "Choose where you are".

r2n3.text:
To confirm: the Watching tab lists the same rows as Saved (one column on a phone, two on the web) and not the poster grid the other tabs have. A poster a third of a phone wide has no room for the bar and a thumb-sized check.

The row has no sort or filter chips: the latest started comes first.
